title: Conjunctive Continuous Performance Task jsPsych plugin
description: jsPsych 6 plugin and example timeline for the Conjunctive Continuous Performance Task (CCPT; Shalev et al., 2011), a sustained-attention task in which participants respond only to one shape-color conjunction. Zenodo assigns the DOI for this snapshot when it archives the GitHub release; the DOI is not set in this file.
